title: A founder writes his own votes out of the charter — 'I designed it to hand off, not to entrench myself indefinitely'
summary: Birchler drafted NICER's first governance from the Incorruptible manuscript before he had spoken to a lawyer: a purpose trust with escalating board control and veto rights over ingredients, suppliers and acquisitions. Counsel talked him down, and he shipped a Delaware PBC with 10x founder voting as a bridge and one reserved share held for a mission guardian.
blockquote: The day I issue that reserved share, my ten votes become one, because I designed it to hand off, not to entrench myself indefinitely.
attribution_title: Founder & Chief Scientist, NICER · VP Engineering at IMVU with Eric Ries, who sits on NICER's advisory board
